The '''Galactic Center Spaceport''' was located on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[44 ABY]], the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] came under the control of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who had infiltrated the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|government]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], during the [[New Jedi Order]]'s mission to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|liberate]] Coruscant from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived at the Galactic Center Spaceport in the [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] ''[[Plain Lady]]''.
